title: AI Control Tower
description: Governance and observability view of an enterprise AI programme: adoption, token economics, DORA metrics, agent registry, model governance, risk and policies.
insights: AI-assisted teams are faster (lead time -54%) but less stable: change failure rate rose from 5.8% to 9.1%.
AVRR is 5.1x on EUR 2.74M monthly AI spend, driven by 18,000 weekly active users.
47 unregistered AI assets and 31 overprivileged agent identities are the most urgent governance gaps.
10 of 18 EU AI Act conformity assessments are still outstanding.
Figures in this space are illustrative sample data, not live measurements.
prompt: Bundled example: AI Control Tower dashboard (static, not agent-generated).
